title: UniPool global expert pool + Mirror layer role
hypothesis: On held-out character-language sequences, a shared global MoE expert pool with compact layer-specific orthogonal Mirror input views can recover useful layer specialization with near-Untied NLL while using fewer actual serialized inference bytes than layer-owned experts, and outperform byte-near simple input gates or native depth-conditioning controls.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: four global FFN experts shared across all four Transformer layers
mirror_insertion.coordinate: eight fixed-pair Givens rotation angles per layer applied to the expert input
mirror_insertion.logical_function: layer-specific realization of the same physical expert bank
mirror_insertion.router_interface: Mirror Givens and byte-matched FiLM act only after routing, on selected expert inputs. The router sees the unmodified normalized layer activation. The MoRE-style depth embedding is added before both router and expert.

dataset.name: Tiny Shakespeare character corpus
dataset.source: Karpathy char-rnn public-domain Shakespeare input.txt (raw URL recorded in data acquisition script)
dataset.split: After download, SHA-256 and character count are logged. For N characters: train [0,floor(.8N)), development [floor(.8N),floor(.9N)), audit [floor(.9N),N). Windows never cross a split boundary. Vocabulary is derived from training characters only; unseen development/audit characters map to one fixed UNK symbol.
dataset.audit_access: only after both development gates pass; audit span indices sealed in pre-run manifest

model.routing: Top-1 NormRouter: per-layer router logits normalized by L2 norm, ReLU, multiplied by deterministic Appendix-L Monte Carlo scale c and a learned per-layer scalar. The selected expert output is scaled by its selected NormRouter score.
model.load_balancing: Untied MoE uses per-layer auxiliary balancing. All global-pool conditions use one pool-level auxiliary loss from mean expert score and assignment rates aggregated over all layers; coefficient 0.01.

conditions: untied standard 4-expert-per-layer MoE with per-layer NormRouter and per-layer balancing
UniPool-style full-pool access during all training, four global experts, independent per-layer NormRouters, aggregate pool-level balancing
UniPool + 8D/layer depth embedding through a shared projection (MoRE-style control)

training.checkpoint_rule: best development NLL among fixed checkpoints every 100 updates
training.hyperparameter_tuning: none after protocol freeze; the fixed schedule is a mechanism screen, not a capacity claim

gates.quality_storage: Across both development seeds, Mirror validation NLL must be <= untied MoE +0.10 nats and complete serialized inference payload <=0.70x untied MoE.
gates.mirror_specific: At matched payload within +/-5%, Mirror must improve validation NLL by >=0.02 nats over both UniPool+FiLM and UniPool+depth-embedding; otherwise no Mirror-specific benefit is established.
gates.audit: Only if both gates pass in both development seeds; no audit tuning.

metrics: development and audit next-character NLL and bits/character
actual serialized inference payload bytes including token vocabulary/config/view codes
training tokens, updates, wall time, active expert MAC proxy
pairwise layer-role expert-output distance on a shared held-out activation batch

paid_objects: depth embedding projection for its control

compute.measure: single-thread CPU wall time per update and inference pass; analytic active-MAC proxy
compute.caveat: short CPU mechanism screen only, no optimized serving claim

fresh.meaning: Fixed RNG seeds to sample evaluation windows from the locked audit span; trained weights remain unchanged.

boundaries: small character language model only; no general Transformer or large-language-model claim
fixed 1200-update schedule cannot establish asymptotic capacity
expert combination counts are not independent capacity
softmax/top-1 implementation and CPU runtime must be reported exactly

audit_gate.apply_to_each_development_world_seed_on_: Mirror next-character NLL must be <= untied MoE +0.10 nats and <= both byte-near UniPool+FiLM and UniPool+depth-embedding controls by at least 0.02 nats. Inference bytes are unchanged from the already measured checkpoint payload. Any miss is FAIL; no tuning.

amendments.timing: before corpus acquisition and before any model/data metrics
amendments.change: Specify the final audit decision gate after code review.
amendments.rationale: The original protocol specified when to open audit but left the post-audit decision rule implicit. Freeze the same quality and Mirror-specific thresholds for audit before opening it.

amendments.timing: before corpus acquisition and any model/data metrics
amendments.change: Refined all MoE routing controls to PA205 NormRouter and pool-level balancing, and fixed the exact Mirror/FiLM expert-input insertion after routing.
amendments.rationale: Full-text PA205 confirms UniPool-Full uses top-1 NormRouter and aggregate pool-level balancing; per-layer balancing is retained only for the untied private-expert control. Givens/FiLM do not alter the independent router, while the MoRE depth embedding conditions routing and experts.

routing_calibration.normrouter: PA205 Appendix L Monte Carlo formula; 100000 standard-normal samples, fixed seed 78300, four candidates, top-1; fixed c is deterministic from algorithm and configuration. Each MoE layer has a learned scalar initialized to 1.
routing_calibration.capacity: no capacity drop; each token selects one expert
